samples.title: Mounting Bracket
samples.description: Machined aluminium bracket: base plate + upright rib, bolt-circle holes, fillets. Teaches the core modelling loop: box primitives, bolt_circle, fillet, material.
what_it_teaches: Box primitives with merge (fuse) to build compound bodies

samples.title: Enclosure Lid (with CAM)
samples.description: Aluminium lid with mounting holes and a pre-generated GRBL G-code CAM job. Demonstrates the cam_program fast-path: face mill + contour2d, with simulation verification.
what_it_teaches: GRBL G-code output and machining simulation
bolt_circle on a thin plate for corner mounting
Reading cam simulation metrics (cycle_time, machined_fraction, gouges)

samples.title: Portal Frame (Weldment)
samples.description: Welded steel portal frame: two uprights + top beam from 40×40×2 square tube, auto-mitred at joints. Demonstrates the weld_member sweep feature and cut-list workflow.
what_it_teaches: Sketch path as a weld_member spine (open line segments)
Multi-body result: one solid per member segment
Mitre corner trimming at shared vertices
